summary: 55-year-old female hiker from Longmont suffered chest pain near the Arapahoe Pass Trail / Diamond Lake Trail turnoff; litter-carried to the Fourth of July Trailhead and transported to Boulder by AMR after a ~2-hour rescue
location: Diamond Lake area, Arapahoe Pass Trail-Diamond Lake Trail turnoff, Indian Peaks Wilderness
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Nederland Fire Protection District; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; American Medical Response; U.S. Forest Service
notes: BCSO case #20-3447; reported 1:31 p.m. via radio relayed by a USFS employee who hiked out to the trailhead
